verdict.rationale: Signup automatically creates a Buyer Agent with a pre-funded wallet. The agent spends from it through pay tokens whose amounts are committed against the wallet's available balance. A documented wallet-balance API returns available, held, pending-charge and pending-deposit amounts. Control is exercised through per-agent API keys and account deactivation, and the token amount acts as a spending ceiling. Missing for 10: a documented self-serve top-up flow for individual users (wallet funding beyond the pre-funded start is only shown via the Enterprise Credits Wallet Embed SDK), owner-set wallet-level spending limits or per-token revocation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of funding and balance flows.
